content:
Apple will launch multiple new products this fall, including new iPhones, Macs, iPads and more. Here's every Apple product expected to debut from September 9 onwards.

iPhones: Brand new iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max, as well as the iPhone Ultra

Apple's flagship iPhone 18 lineup is going ultra-premium this fall, reportedly no longer including a base iPhone 18, which is expected to arrive in early 2027.

  • iPhone 18 Pro: Major camera upgrades, new unique colors, smaller Dynamic Island, and more
  • iPhone 18 Pro Max: The largest battery ever, and may exclusively feature a camera capability
  • iPhone Ultra: The first foldable iPhone from Apple

Wearables: AirPods 5, Apple Watch Ultra 4, Apple Watch Series 12

Apple is reportedly set to announce three new wearables at its September event: AirPods 5, along with updates to its two flagship Apple Watch models.

  • AirPods 5: A refreshed model with both a basic and active noise cancellation (ANC) version
  • Apple Watch Ultra 4: New health sensors, design update, and more
  • Apple Watch Series 12: Upgraded S-series chip, new health features

Mac: MacBook Ultra, all-new M6 MacBook Pro, and more

Apple has already launched quite a few new Macs this year, but three more models are reportedly on the way, expected in October.

  • MacBook Ultra: A new high-end model featuring an OLED display, touch support, and more
  • M6 MacBook Pro: An entry-level MacBook Pro refresh with the M6 chip
  • M6 iMac: Redesigned color options

iPad: OLED iPad mini and possibly a base iPad

A new iPad Air launched earlier this year, but two more iPads may arrive before year's end: an iPad mini with OLED, and a new base iPad.

  • New iPad mini: OLED display and upgraded chip
  • Base iPad: Equipped with the A18 chip to support Apple Intelligence

Apple Home products: Apple TV 4K, HomePad, and more

Apple has long had ambitions to significantly expand its Home lineup, but has reportedly been waiting for Siri AI features to be ready. Here's what's in the pipeline.

  • New Apple TV 4K: Upgraded A-series chip, Apple Intelligence, all-new Siri Remote
  • HomePad / HomePod Touch: A brand new home hub with a 7-inch touchscreen and magnetic base
  • HomePod 3: A refreshed full-size HomePod with a new chip to support Apple Intelligence
  • HomePod mini 2: New chip, improved sound, and more
  • Apple security camera: An official smart home accessory for HomeKit Secure Video

Apple has also reportedly been working on a Face ID-equipped video doorbell product, but there haven't been updates on that for a long time.

Of all the new Apple products launching this fall, which one are you planning to buy? Let us know in the comments.
